summary: Victory Pay auto-approve + My Orders + QR-2min iteration tested end-to-end. Backend: 39/39 pytest tests PASSED (35 prior regression + 4 NEW targeted tests for this iteration). NEW coverage: (t71) GET /api/tasks/my-payments returns orders with order_id/status/credit/reward/amount/utr/currency/created_at and NO screenshot leak. (t72) Fresh (<15 min) payment stays 'pending' — /auth/me does NOT auto-credit. (t73) AUTO-APPROVE-AFTER-15-MIN verified deterministically by ageing a pending payment created_at to 16 minutes ago directly in Mongo (db=victory_pay, collection task_payments), then calling GET /api/auth/me: payment flips to status='approved' with note='Auto-approved after 15 minutes', processed_at set, balance += credit, total_earned += reward, plan_activation row created; SECOND /auth/me call proves NO double-credit (balance/total_earned unchanged). (t74) Global auto_approve_due() also fires from GET /api/admin/summary: another user's aged pending payment auto-approves + credits when admin hits /admin/summary. Prior regression: admin approve still credits via shared _approve_payment helper (balance += credit, total_earned += reward, plan_activation created); reject leaves balance untouched. Frontend (mobile 390x844): after login as test1@example.com, dismissed onboarding modal, navigated to /profile — 'mine-menu-My Orders' testID present, tap navigates to /orders. Orders screen renders 3 orders (all Approved from prior tests) with correct testIDs (order-VP3269949011, order-VP8478660361, order-VP0292039818) showing Task Name, date (26 Jul, 11:15 am), status badge 'Approved', Order ID, Paid Amount (₹4,000), Profit/Reward (+₹112), Wallet Credit (₹4,122), UTR/Txn ID (123456789012). orders-back-button works and returns to /profile. Since all listed orders were already Approved, order-auto-hint not visible (correct — it only shows on pending). Payment screen (/payment/task_...): payment-qr renders, 'QR auto-refreshes every 2 minutes' hint text present, QR interval confirmed 120000ms in code. Post-payment success overlay routes to /orders (router.replace('/orders')) — confirmed via code inspection. Deprecated packages detected: none. RN-Web deprecation warnings persist (shadow* -> boxShadow, props.pointerEvents -> style.pointerEvents) — cosmetic only.

issues: Onboarding welcome modal auto-shows on Home/Profile and can block interaction until user taps Skip/Next. Verified it does NOT persist after dismissal, but E2E automation must Skip first. Not a blocker.

action_items: (Cosmetic, non-blocking) Replace shadow* StyleSheet props with `boxShadow` in /app/frontend/src/theme.ts to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings across all cards (orders/profile/home/etc).
(Cosmetic, non-blocking) Move `pointerEvents` JSX prop into `style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}` in AnimatedIntro/Toast/payment pulseRing.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 758 lines — over the 700 LOC guideline. Recommend splitting into modules (routers/auth, routers/tasks, routers/admin, routers/wallet, routers/support, services/payments).

_approve_payment() correctly re-reads {status:'pending'} before crediting — double-credit safe. The 60-second background loop + lazy triggers on /auth/me, /tasks/my-payments, /admin/summary provide multiple safety nets.

auto_approve_due() iterates in Python and calls _approve_payment sequentially. Under a burst of hundreds of aged pending payments this could be slow; consider using an update_many with $currentDate + atomic ledger append, or a job queue. Not urgent given current scale.
task_payments still store base64 screenshot inline in Mongo docs — noted in prior iteration; document size can grow. Consider GridFS/S3 later.
/orders screen keyExtractor uses payment_id (good). FlatList is fine for typical volumes; consider pagination if a user accumulates hundreds of orders.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical testIDs render: mine-menu-My Orders, order-<VP...>, orders-back-button, payment-qr, and 'QR auto-refreshes every 2 minutes' hint; navigation + integration verified)
